historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly requires operator participation and per-cycle evidence, but does not resolve AC removal versus logical off, discharge/dwell/readiness timing, stable link identity or the SY.1 evidence linkage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds destructive-test authorization, safe rack/PDU control, console/BMC recovery, individually numbered cycles and preservation of the first failure.

original_test_intent: Demonstrate repeatable GPU discovery and maximum-generation x16 PCIe link training with zero correctable or uncorrectable errors after each of 25 complete cold AC removals and restorations, or through an explicitly traceable equivalent SY.1 checkpoint.
original_method: Map every GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF to its root port, switch and maximum supported generation/width; define controlled AC-off command or PDU outlet, full-power-loss proof, discharge and off/on dwell, boot/readiness deadlines and cycle numbering; preserve the pre-run baseline; have an operator supervise each of 25 cycles; collect fresh inventory, link state, AER, GPU and platform logs after every boot; stop at the first failure and retain the failed state for owner recovery rather than cycling through it.
manual_activity: An authorized operator drains the SUT, controls the exact AC source for every iteration, observes complete loss and restoration, and owns failed-boot or hardware recovery.
required_inputs: Approved NVIDIA PCIe/GPU qualification and inventory/link/error collection tools
GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF to root-port/switch topology with per-link maximum generation and x16 requirement
Exact cold-AC PDU/outlet or physical procedure, full-power-loss proof, discharge/off/on dwell and boot/readiness deadlines
SY.1 evidence mapping, maintenance authorization, per-cycle acceptance, first-fault abort and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated drained non-production SUT with approved rack/PDU control and console/BMC recovery
Confirm the outlet and power domain before each AC action; never cycle adjacent equipment
Preserve persistent and volatile failure evidence and do not clear logs for baseline convenience
Stop after the first boot timeout, missing GPU, link below its approved maximum x16, any new correctable/uncorrectable error, abnormal power/thermal state or loss of recovery access
No automatic retry or unsupervised cycle loop
agent_execution_scope: Validate power target, topology, maximum-link matrix, cycle timing, readiness checks, SY.1 linkage and recovery
Automate evidence capture and cycle accounting, but require the approved operator for each AC transition
Compare every GPU and link against baseline and the explicit matrix after every one of 25 boots
Do not clear logs, infer a missing iteration, continue after a fault, power-cycle blindly or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the cold-AC mechanism and timing, full-power-loss proof, 25-cycle count and SY.1 inheritance contract
Approve topology/maximum-link expectations, per-iteration evidence and stop/recovery rules
Review all 25 complete iteration records and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its inventory and link commands are relevant post-cycle checks, but the case also needs an approved physical power primitive, complete-loss verification, timing, readiness and a topology-specific maximum-link oracle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Under operator control, perform exactly 25 approved full AC-off/on sequences, recording complete loss, timing and a full GPU/link/error/platform evidence set for each numbered iteration; stop on the first deviation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Twenty-five cold AC cycles, SY.1 subset relationship, maximum supported generation x16, zero correctable/uncorrectable errors, no bundle, and 5/720-minute allocation remain; power timing and topology are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH DESTRUCTIVE 25-CYCLE COLD AC GPU PCIE RETRAIN QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a transaction-like cycle ledger: begin from a known healthy state, record the exact AC transition and timestamps, then accept the iteration only after all GPUs, links, errors and management surfaces reach the approved state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact power-domain control, full-loss and timing proof, stable per-link expectations, independently numbered evidence, first-fault retention and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final snapshot or inherited SY.1 PASS can hide intermittent missing GPUs, transient downtraining, corrected errors, incomplete AC removal or unobserved failed iterations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated hard AC interruption destroys runtime state and stresses PSU, GPU and PCIe initialization; an incorrect outlet or unsupervised loop has rack-level blast radius.

project_override_considerations: SY.1 may satisfy this case only when its artifacts explicitly include the same 25 cold AC transitions and the full per-cycle GPU/link/error matrix. DC/S5 cycling, warm reboot or generic system availability does not replace physical AC-loss coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner authorization, tool versions, SUT power-domain identity and SY.1 traceability
GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF and root-port/switch maximum-generation x16 matrix with clean baseline
Twenty-five numbered operator/PDU action records with AC-loss proof, off/on dwell, boot and readiness timestamps
For every cycle: complete GPU inventory, lspci LnkSta/capabilities and AER status, nvidia-smi, dmesg/journal, BMC/SEL, power/thermal/health state
First-fault and recovery evidence if stopped, or final stable state after iteration 25
Engineer PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED decision; no review-layer DUT verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, Criteria and same-row reviews consistently require 25 cold AC cycles and per-cycle GPU PCIe recovery. The SY.1 shortcut is an evidence dependency whose equivalence must be approved, not a contradictory objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The cold-AC retrain purpose and acceptance direction are clear. Operator, tooling, topology, timing and SY.1 evidence can be supplied, so the static review is not irreducibly blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2145 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00022-V002: approve the exact PDU/outlet or physical cold-AC sequence, full-power-loss and discharge/off/on dwell, boot/readiness deadlines, 25-cycle accounting, GPU UUID/slot/BDF-to-root-port/switch maximum-generation x16 matrix, SY.1 equivalence and artifact mapping, zero-error interpretation, first-fault aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Makes each destructive AC cycle independently auditable and prevents an aggregate SY.1 label or final healthy snapshot from hiding intermittent GPU or PCIe failures.
independent_technical_reasoning: Cold AC cycling tests initialization from complete auxiliary-power loss, which is materially different from S5 or reset. Link training failures may be intermittent and corrected-error records may disappear or be obscured after another cycle, so evidence must be captured before the next power action. The run stops at the first fault because continuing both destroys the diagnostic state and adds unapproved stress without improving the failed acceptance result.
